key_unknowns: Company-adjusted LTM EBITDA and adjusted net-debt/EBITDA are UNAVAILABLE (not in the revised 99.1 guidance) — the covenant-basis leverage and the adjusted forward multiple cannot be checked; treat this missing disclosure as a bearish opacity, not a neutral gap.

No segment EBITDA is disclosed — the filing segments revenue across 6 units (Others 40%, US 20%, India 18%, etc.) but not profitability, so the quality of the growth by geography is unverifiable — a bearish disclosure gap.
The 5y P/E percentile cannot be built because a stock split inside the window divides split-adjusted prices against as-filed EPS — the P/E level stands but its historical position is unknown.

EV/EBITDA is trailing-only with no forward basis in-source at the own-history level — the near-floor 11th percentile cannot distinguish a temporarily depressed level from a permanently impaired one (a neutral fact for the human to resolve).
The durability of the four-quarter growth streak is untested against the new personalization/Bioniq/Pro2col rollouts, which are in beta and unproven at scale.
The 4.250% Convertible Senior Notes ($273.4M) mature 2028-06-15; the 10-Q states no near-term maturity wall but the refinance/repay/convert path before that date is unresolved.
The capital-structure panel is 177d old (filed 2026-02-18) and predates the April refinancing; the CIQ instrument schedule may not reflect the current post-refi stack.

business_description.value: Herbalife Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides health and wellness products in North America, Mexico, South and Central America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, China, and the Asia Pacific. It offers weight management products, including meal replacement, protein shakes, drink mixes, weight loss supplements, healthy snacks, and metabolism boosting teas; targeted nutrition products comprising functional beverages and dietary and nutritional supplements containing herbs, vitamins, minerals and other natural ingredients; energy, sports, and fitness products; and facial skin care, body care, and hair care products. The company also provides literature, promotional, and other materials, such as start-up kits, sales tools, and educational materials. It sells its products through sales representatives, independent service providers, and company-operated retail stores and platforms. The company was formerly known as Herbalife Nutrition Ltd. and changed its name to Herbalife Ltd. in April 2023. Herbalife Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.
